creator: bengusberg
title: Founder testimonial for OpenAI's proactive 'dots' agent: it unprompted texted him not to chase an invoice already scheduled for payment, and surfaced a creator's reply that went to spam

tools.name: OpenAI dots (ChatGPT 'dot' agent)
tools.detail: Open ChatGPT, update to latest version, click your dot in the upper-left corner; runs 24/7 with its own computer and Chrome browser

claims: dots is a new kind of OpenAI agent that works 24/7 on its own computer and Chrome browser and proactively acts without being asked

Twice in two days it stopped the creator from a mistake: (1) flagged that a company he was about to dun had already emailed saying payment arrives October 2nd; (2) flagged an unread creator reply with availability that had gone to spam a week earlier
Creator never told the dot about either situation; it inferred from his email
Creator says he is not paid by OpenAI; he is a Stanford founder of an AI startup that raised $4M
how_to_steps: Open ChatGPT and update to the latest version
Click your dot in the upper-left corner to set it up
Let it run; it reads your email/calendar context and texts you proactively
on_screen_only: 'Introducing dots' launch graphic with a blue blob mascot

Screenshot of an iMessage-style thread: dot says the payment email came from a Ramp email 'September 26' and 'October 2 was my estimate', creator replies 'awesome! thanks for making me not sound like an idiot'; dot replies 'Haha glad we caught it before you hit send'
Screenshot of a ChatGPT desktop chat window with blurred message bubbles
cta: Try it out and let me know what you build; follow for more

relevance.why: Haji has repeatedly liked proactive personal-agent content (Instinct, Jarvis, Town, Grok bot, Meta Muse / ChatGPT Dots comparison). This is a concrete inbox-watching use case (missed replies, don't-dun-the-client) that maps directly onto his time-poor founder life, but it is an OpenAI consumer product, not a Claude Code technique.

implement_score.why: Nothing to build; it is a feature toggle inside ChatGPT. The reusable idea is a 'pre-send sanity check' agent over Gmail: before sending a chase email, search the thread for an existing answer. That could be a small Claude Code + Gmail MCP skill, but Haji already has Town/Instinct-style tools on his radar.

verify: Does the ChatGPT 'dots' feature exist and is it available on Haji's ChatGPT plan/region?
What email/calendar access does it require and what are the privacy terms?
Is the creator's second example (spam detection) real behavior or a one-off?

gap.what: Duplicate of liked content: the liked set already has an agent comparison covering 'ChatGPT Dots' plus several proactive-assistant reviews (Instinct, Town). Only new detail is the specific 'already-paid invoice' catch.
